passages.title: FUL-3091 · Recorded fulfillment briefing
passages.section: What supports a later status update
passages.text: A later consent update needs an intake-team finding; a later pharmacy-stage update needs pharmacy confirmation; carrier possession and delivery need the corresponding shipment or delivery record. Describe only the milestone that the source establishes and retain outstanding questions about later stages. Conversations, generated drafts and conditional process examples do not update the recorded scenario. In the present snapshot, consent is still missing and shipment remains unconfirmed.
passages.reason: Matches the meaning of the question and recent conversation in the selected case.

passages.title: Patient status-message examples
passages.text: Example response to “I filled out the enrollment form. Does that mean it is on the way?”: “Enrollment received means the program has your enrollment information. It does not mean the pharmacy has released a shipment. In this recorded case, the consent signature is still missing, and there is no confirmed carrier handoff.” Keep the explanation administrative and patient-friendly. Do not add medical advice, a delivery estimate or an assurance that all pharmacy checks have passed.

passages.title: Patient status-message examples
passages.section: Reply to a reported consent submission
passages.text: Conditional example, only after a patient reports submitting consent: “Thank you for letting us know. The next step is to ask the intake team to confirm that the signed consent was received and is complete. That confirmation is separate from the pharmacy’s review and shipment status.” This is suggested wording for a future reply. It does not establish that the program checked receipt, that the form is complete or that the medication is on its way.

passages.title: Consent and intake troubleshooting
passages.text: If program intake, pharmacy intake and the patient describe different stages, retain each attributed report and ask the relevant team to reconcile the discrepancy. Clarify whether each report concerns enrollment, consent, prescription intake, dispense release or shipment. An older or differently scoped update may not answer the current question. Do not select the most advanced status merely because it sounds reassuring, and do not apply another patient’s shipping record to FUL-3091.

workProduct.subject: Update on your enrollment and next steps
workProduct.body:
Hi Taylor,

Thanks — we’ve received your enrollment and the pharmacy has recorded the prescription for review. A signature on the consent form is still needed; please complete it through the program’s secure channel. The pharmacy must finish its checks before shipment can be confirmed, and no shipment confirmation is recorded.

Thanks,
Jordan Rivera
Willow Support
jordan.rivera@willow-support.example

passages.title: FUL-3091 · Recorded fulfillment briefing
passages.text: Jordan Rivera’s objective is to explain the current administrative position and help identify the next confirmation needed. The immediate recorded item is the required consent signature. Jordan can direct the patient to the established secure program process and ask intake to confirm receipt and completeness. Jordan cannot complete consent for the patient, validate a prescription, authorize dispensing or turn a draft status message into actual pharmacy outreach.

passages.title: Consent and intake troubleshooting
passages.section: A form was received but is incomplete
passages.text: If intake confirms a form was received but identifies a missing signature or unreadable section, explain that exact issue and ask the team for the established secure correction instructions. Avoid saying that no form was received when the problem is completeness. Do not assume a new full enrollment is required, invent a form expiry date or prescribe a signature method absent from the program’s instructions. A correction request does not itself resolve the missing item.
passages.reason: Matches the meaning of the question and recent conversation in the selected case.

passages.title: Enrollment and consent prerequisites
passages.text: A completed enrollment form and the required signed consent are administrative prerequisites for advancing the synthetic support enrollment. A submitted or received form is not necessarily complete. Missing consent must be resolved and its receipt checked; do not claim that resolution alone guarantees dispensing.
